title: bupleurum semicompositum f. normale
intro: Bupleurum semicompositum f. normale, commonly known as Bupleurum or Chinese Thorowax, is a type of flowering plant in the family Apiaceae. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and fever, as well as aiding in the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Bupleurum semicompositum f. normale include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and immunomodulatory effects, making it a popular remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
